verdict.rationale: Aider's documented automation is a single session that runs one instruction via `--message` or `coder.run()` and then exits. Nothing in the evidence shows first-party orchestration of parallel agent fleets or long-running autonomous work lasting hours or days. The community 'navigator-mode' autonomy is a third-party add-on, and running many scripted instances in parallel would be a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days
